description: Na₄ZnSe₃ crystallizes in the monoclinic Cc space group. There are four inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.93-3.15 Å. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to three Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.83-2.88 Å. In the third Na site, Na is bonded to four Se atoms to form distorted corner-sharing NaSe₄ trigonal pyramids. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.88-3.02 Å. In the fourth Na site, Na is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three Se atoms. There are a spread of Na-Se bond distances ranging from 2.78-2.86 Å. Zn is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to three Se atoms. There are a spread of Zn-Se bond distances ranging from 2.39-2.43 Å. There are three inequivalent Se sites. In the first Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Zn atom to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing SeNa₅Zn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-64°. In the second Se site, Se is bonded to five Na and one Zn atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing SeNa₅Zn octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-57°. In the third Se site, Se is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to four Na and one Zn atom.
